Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This documents out lines the check list 
 I2, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 at the 
 titled block.
The first draft was initiated by eng. Alsayed 
Abdel Monem Al-Geddawy, and tested on the feeder no. 40
at Fifth
Urban Community 66kv Substation at
21 Agust.2002 
Cairo Zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area must be used.
Wearing safety helmet, safety shoes, masks
 are necessary.
Switch off DC source
Environmental Precautions
Before start cleaning, wear 
breathing mask to protect lung tissues from dust particles and chemical solvent 
which, if exist, expose lungs to danger
Don't throw any cleaning 
liquid 
on ground,
collect it and send to dumb.
Don't burn clothes used in cleaning, 
collect it and send to dumb
Tools and Equipment
Suitable 
 tool set
Pieces of 
 clothes and rags
Grease and 
 cleaning liquid (like gasoline)
Helmet, 
 safe shoes and masks
Work to be Carried Out
Clean 
 porcelain insulators of the circuit breaker from dust, dirties, deposits 
 ....etc.
Check 
 porcelain insulators to be free of cracking and scratching
Inspect well the flower 
 contacts and check it to be in good condition, check its 
 component (fingers) to be correct order and the spring compressed it is in 
 good condition .
Clean flower contacts, remove the old grease 
 from the contacts and then put new thin film of 
 grease on it .
Check the contact arms to be well 
 fixed and in horizontal position to avoid bad contact between breaker contact 
 and bas bar contact .
Inspect the pressure of SF6 gas and it to be in the safe 
 area (green area)
Clean the 
 socket by video cleaner
Check 
 the mechanism of the circuit breaker, clean it with gas and grease it, check 
 its parts for easy move
Switch on 
 the circuit breaker and off in test position mechanically and electrically
Oiling the 
 wheels of breaker tracks to make it easily move in and out of cell
Measure the contact resistance
Measure switching time (switching off time and switching on 
 time)
